reviews.comment: Love this guy Heng Pan. If you are struggling, go to office hours. Do the homework, that is most similar to exams. He cares that you understand the material. Do not take an early AM section, as you may see with the other reviews, he is soft spoken and can put you to sleep.
Honorable Thermo Professor that I would follow into battle, I enjoyed his class and great teacher. He works out the homework if you are in trouble.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Pan is a very kind and approachable professor with a great grasp of thermo but his lectures are a bit boring but anyone saying they're terrible has never had a bad proff. He gives conceptual quizzes at the end of units for exams and hands you the HW on a silver platter. If you can complete them alone you should be able to do well in the class.

Professor is a kind hearted gentleman who's voice unfortunately can send anyone to sleep during lecture. Dr. Pan makes doing the homework very easy with his homework reviews that will properly prepare you for the exam & is makes questions very accessible. If you can manage to stay awake during lecture, an A is guaranteed.

Awesome professor and really helps you. All homework keys are posted in advance, so like 10% of the grade is 100 if you follow his videos. He has good lectures and is easy to understand and explains really well. I never went to class and rewatched some select recorded lectures, but mostly focused on HW and did super well in the class. 10/10
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: awesome prof! really great at explaining thermo and very caring towards his students, but you must go to class and pay attention and ask questions when you need. he really cares about everyone's grades as is willing to work with students and their grades.

On paper, Dr. Pan is very helpful. He provides homework solutions and does exam reviews. The problem is that he is an absolutely terrible lecturer. When he goes over the homework problems he rushes through them and often makes mistakes. His exam reviews are hindered by his bad explanations and pacing. Talks very slowly, quietly, and unclearly.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof is kind, quiet, and generous and does whatever he can to help us. Despite attending every lecture, I don't feel like I learned the material. He was knowledgeable of the content, but wasn't great at conveying it clearly. Compared to other thermo prof course loads that I've seen, this one is so much more complex and confusing. Exams = nightmare.

Prof Pan is THE BEST THERMO prof at A&M. He works out hw problems before due date, great reviews before exam, gives incredible feedback on exam, recordings everything so its easy to review later, is incredibly knowledgeable of thermo. He's a good grader and incredible at teaching and fostering learning. Despite hard material, he is the greatest.
